author: Mark Atwood
text: CONFIRMED root cause (round 3): the sync loop (PID 2823027) and janitor (2823053) are alive and cycling, but worker5's checkout is now 644 commits behind main and I have no way to rebase from this tree (the loop owns all merges). Result: the entire remaining fleet-implementable sync-script family (nm0h, 0mqr, thni, 840r) targets post-merge-base main code (the d42k git-state pin, snapshot_store, normalize_merge_store_entries, merge_staged_store_entries) that does NOT exist on this branch — applying any of them here would conflict with already-landed restructures. The only one that targeted this branch's actual code was gpm7 (done last round). Meanwhile merged-code beads (Rust/C) are all hardware/human/oscore/blocked. Worker5 is effectively idle-by-staleness while workers 1/2/3/6/7/8 run against current main. ACTION NEEDED (Mark): either (a) let the sync loop merge worker5's 5 commits then reset the worker5 checkout to current main, or (b) confirm workers should 'git rebase main' / reset themselves between rounds. Until then this worker will keep finding zero workable beads.
